[ This is a sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values in [0,49]. The dominant strategy is to bid my true value because I pay the second-highest bid if I win; shading or overbidding cannot increase expected profit. There is only 1 round, so no history to exploit. In a sealed-bid second-price auction with independent private values, the weakly dominant strategy is to bid your true value. Overbidding risks winning at a price above your value; underbidding risks losing when you’d profit. With no informative history and risk-neutral objective, bidding exactly your value maximizes expected profit this round. Therefore, bid your value of 33 to capture all profitable wins without overpaying.
